proposal.rationale: Pursuing area/resource relief. Previous attempts to reduce area yielded no resource score improvements, likely because the capacity reductions were not aggressive enough for this extremely small workload. Boldly shrinking CONFIG_SLM_KBYTES to 16 and CONFIG_ACC_CACHES to 64 sets with 2-way associativity aims to aggressively cut into the 18.2% BRAM and 43.98% LUT utilization without hurting the 63-cycle latency.
proposal.search_intent: Aggressively shrink SLM and accelerator caches to reduce BRAM and LUT utilization.
